title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
description: The CTO and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a company claiming to restore ransomware-locked data using advanced cryptographic tools, was indicted for wire fraud. The company secretly paid ransomware attackers for decryption keys and charged victims significantly more than the cost paid, while falsely claiming not to pay ransoms or negotiate with threat actors. An FBI sting operation exposed these deceptive practices. Victims were misled into paying large fees for services that were not performed, with the company deleting ransomware notes to prevent victims from contacting attackers directly.
